messages.subject: Getting Probe IDs in the unitName column
parts:

I am new to Aroma and I'm trying to normalize some Cel file data with
HuGene-st-v1 to perform some statistical analyses. I installed aroma
and ran the normalization as described here
http://www.aroma-project.org/vignettes/GeneSTArrayAnalysis but when I
take a look at the final product, gExprs, there are no probe names,
just numbers. Does that mean the CDF file is not being accessed
correctly? Is there further processing I need to do to retreive the
Probe IDs?
